ycy git cm
Generate an Angular-style commit message from uncommitted changes
Usage:
  ycy git cm [flags]
Flags:
  -b, --body	Allow a short commit body
  -d, --dry-run	Generate and print only
  -h, --help	help for cm
  -l, --lang	Commit message language: en or zh
  --profile	CM provider profile to use
  -p, --push	Push to remote after creating the commit, defaults to origin
  -s, --stage	Select files to stage before generating
  -a, --stage-all	Stage all changes before generating
  -c, --stage-push	Select files to stage, commit, then push, defaults to origin
  -S, --staged	Only use staged changes
  --timeout-ms	Provider request timeout in milliseconds
  --log-format	Diagnostic format: text or json
  --log-level	Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
  --quiet	Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose	Enable debug diagnostics
